verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents the Admin SDK Reports API, which lets administrators view and query their domain's audit and usage reports programmatically, including login activity reports. An Alerts API is also documented. This covers the queryable-log and API-access parts of the story, but nothing in the evidence shows native streaming or export to a SIEM. Missing for 10: native SIEM streaming/export integration, detail on identity-event coverage and log schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.
